steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Ahhhh, it's coming...
You and Oliver squeeze into a small tinplate cabinet, so nervous that you can hear each other's heartbeat and breaths.

You're getting weaker and weaker, and gradually losing control of your cotton body. You can only leave the task of detecting enemies to Oliver, and lean against the cold inner wall of the cabinet to support your body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is it a new toy? ...Or is it Eve?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Not sure. I can't see what it looks like from above. But Oliver thinks she's probably not something that would be happy to see us.
Tiptoeing, Oliver peeps out from the crack of the storage cabinet. All that can be seen is an empty corridor.
Clang, clang, clang!
Suddenly there's a banging noise outside the tinplate cabinet, and you both immediately hold your breaths.
You see a tuft of blue-green hair sliding through the crack of the cabinet door. The hair rustles as it gropes on the cabinet door, gradually wrapping around the handle.
The space to move inside the cabinet is very limited. You have no place to hide. All you can do is watch as the hair grabs the edge of the cabinet door.
"Screech..." The rusty friction makes a hair-raising noise.
The door opens. You see a long-haired doll facing away from you.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: A doll just like you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Shh... Let me try something.
You look at the doll before you, who is about your size. You avoid her eerie strands of hair, ready your shackles, and reach out...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Do you need help? You're already in tatters. You might fall apart if you're not careful.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No need. There's something I want to confirm. The puppy just now seemed a bit strange...
——!!! The doll's head suddenly turns around.
Found you.
I want to help Eve. I found you. I want you to leave.
